claims.claim: All Kia and Hyundai genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only one headlight with a PUREGOLD GLOBAL watermark; it cannot prove the seller's full inventory or that new and used Kia/Hyundai parts exist.

claims.claim: This headlight is a genuine Kia or Hyundai part
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows no Kia or Hyundai branding; the visible watermark is PUREGOLD GLOBAL and the witness recorded brand as null.

risks.risk: Whether the headlight works or has been tested
risks.proof: Video clip of the headlight powered on with all functions working

risks.risk: The vehicle make, model, and year it fits
risks.proof: Photo of the part number, fitment label, or screenshot showing compatibility with specific Kia/Hyundai models
risks.if_unproven: priced as fitment unknown; may not fit buyer's vehicle

risks.risk: Whether bulbs, wiring, or ballast are included
risks.proof: Photo showing the complete set of bulbs, wiring harness, and ballast included in the sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as housing only, without bulbs, wiring, or ballast

risks.risk: Condition of internal reflectors and seals
risks.proof: Close-up photo or clip from inside the lens showing reflector condition and seal integrity
risks.if_unproven: priced as reflectors degraded and seals possibly leaking

risks.risk: Seller's location within Abuja or pickup/delivery terms
risks.proof: Screenshot of the seller's location or agreed pickup/delivery terms
risks.if_unproven: priced as buyer-arranged pickup with unknown logistics cost

proof_requests: Video of the headlight powered on
Photo of part number or fitment label
Photo showing included bulbs, wiring, or ballast
Close-up of internal reflectors and seals
Seller location or delivery terms in Abuja
response.reason: The witness identified the item as a car headlight assembly, so it can be valued at its worst case despite missing tests, fitment, and accessories; proof would raise the price.
